primary.body:
## Intent Make the operator COMPLETE decoupled / out-of-band (app-push) 3-D Secure, not just detect it. Today the operator detects the 3DS challenge and waits, but for banks that authenticate the challenge OUT OF BAND (in a mobile banking app, decoupled 3DS) it never receives the completion, so the order never finalizes even though the bank authenticated successfully. Live reproduction (3x, 2026-08-14): Merchant KobeeJapan (store.kobeejapan.net), single-page Shopify checkout, DBS Mastercard (vaulted), rc.21 installed (has #516 checkout fix + 3DS detection). Operator fills card, submits, Stripe requires 3DS -> Stripe hosted challenge renders in a CardinalCommerce iframe (https://hooks.stripe.com/3d_secure_2/hosted?...payment_intent=pi_...&payment_intent_client_secret=...&publishable_key=pk_live_...&stripe_account=acct_...). DBS uses decoupled/app-push 3DS: bank pushes to mobile app, user approves in-app out of band, bank/ACS authenticates OOB. Bug: operator's in-browser challenge frame never receives that OOB completion -- operate_pay's three_ds_wait_seconds elapses and returns payment_3ds_required/needs_user (wall=3ds, resume=checkout). Checkout stays stuck on Cardinal frame + Processing, no order is created, authenticated-but-uncaptured PaymentIntent expires uncaptured. Verified the user approved the push immediately and it still never registered -- not a timing/latency problem, a missing completion path. Root cause (confirmed via code read, not just hypothesis): the operator's 3DS handling (apps/mcp/src/bot/browser.ts detectThreeDsChallenge/waitForThreeDsResolution; apps/mcp/src/bot/pay-operator.ts 3DS state machine) only detected/finalized the IN-FRAME challenge-render case (user completes inside the iframe) via DOM text/URL heuristics, never the DECOUPLED case where completion is signalled server-side (Stripe transitions the PaymentIntent out of requires_action after the ACS confirms OOB). It waited on an in-frame signal that never arrives for app-push banks. Fix implemented: during the 3DS wait, additionally poll the authoritative Stripe PaymentIntent status -- the client_secret + publishable_key are already present in the challenge_url, parsed with a new parseStripeChallengeParams helper (publishable key only, never the secret key -- the same public retrieve-with-client-secret call Stripe.js itself makes client-side). Chose PaymentIntent polling over polling Shopify's own checkout-completion internals because it's the same signal Stripe's SDK relies on, requires no per-merchant-theme reverse engineering, and needs no additional credentials. When the PaymentIntent status leaves requires_action to succeeded/processing/requires_capture (classifyStripePaymentIntentStatus), that's treated as OOB-authenticated: the checkout page is reloaded once so the merchant's own completion logic re-evaluates now-authoritative server state, then the EXISTING DOM-based success detection (unchanged, still covers the in-frame case) gets a bounded ~30s grace window to confirm real order completion. requires_payment_method/canceled PaymentIntent statuses are treated as a definitive failure. Fail-closed: if the grace window elapses without a genuine DOM completion signal, the code returns a new distinct outcome (authenticated_pending_order -> payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order) with needs_user guidance instead of ever silently claiming merchant/amount success on an unconfirmed completion. The original in-frame 3DS path (existing DOM text/URL detection) is completely unchanged and additive only. Money-fence boundaries preserved: single-approval-per-purchase unchanged, one approval authorizes exactly one charge, no re-arm/duplicate/double-charge path added, card only ever opens inside operate_pay, SecretRef.stored:false unaffected, card never exposed to the model. #515 session-addressed payments and the #516 checkout fix + detection + fail-closed confirmation are preserved -- this change is additive to the existing 3DS wait, not a replacement. Tests added: apps/mcp/src/bot/__tests__/browser-payment.test.ts (Stripe challenge URL parsing incl. non-Stripe-host and missing-param refusal, PaymentIntent status classification table, OOB polling+reload+fail-closed-pending, OOB polling+reload+genuine-DOM-success, OOB polling+terminal-failure-status with no reload, and a guard that the ordinary in-frame path never polls Stripe or reloads when no challenge_url is present) and apps/mcp/src/bot/__tests__/pay-operator.test.ts (new payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order status end to end, plus updated existing waitForThreeDsResolution call-signature assertions for the new challenge_url argument). All 70 mcp test files / 1288 tests pass; typecheck clean. The definitive proof is a LIVE retry against a real DBS app-push 3DS challenge, which will be run separately with the captain after merge -- state that in the PR body. Deliver as a PR to staging (not main). Do NOT bump the package version -- that is published separately. ## What Changed - Poll Stripe PaymentIntent status during Stripe-hosted 3DS waits, keep challenge execution active, and reload the checkout once after an observed out-of-band authentication transition so merchant completion logic can resume. - Preserve merchant DOM confirmation as the success gate; treat terminal Stripe failures as declines and return `payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order` with manual-check warnings and repeat-payment blocking when no order is confirmed. - Add regression coverage and documentation for decoupled 3DS parsing, polling, reload, failure, and fail-closed paths. A live DBS app-push retry will be run separately with the captain after merge. ## Risk Assessment ⚠️ Medium: The source is fail-closed and intent-conformant, but this money-path change depends on live browser and issuer timing whose definitive DBS verification is explicitly deferred until after merge. ## Testing The supplied baseline was successful; focused browser/operator tests, an executable OOB status-transition simulation, a real Chrome launch-flag probe, and a real-browser foreground submission check all passed, while the explicitly planned live DBS app-push retry remains separate post-merge proof with the captain.
Evidence: Executable OOB 3DS scenario transcript `App-push + merchant confirmation → succeeded (2 Stripe polls, 1 reload); app-push without merchant confirmation → authenticated_pending_order (1 reload); issuer rejection → failed (no reload); ordinary in-frame challenge → timeout (no Stripe polling or reload).` ```text {"scenario":"app-push authenticated and merchant confirms order","resolution":"succeeded","stripe_status_polls":2,"checkout_reloads":1} {"scenario":"app-push authenticated but merchant never confirms order","resolution":"authenticated_pending_order","stripe_status_polls":4,"checkout_reloads":1} {"scenario":"issuer rejects authentication","resolution":"failed","stripe_status_polls":2,"checkout_reloads":0} {"scenario":"ordinary in-frame challenge without Stripe challenge URL","resolution":"timeout","stripe_status_polls":0,"checkout_reloads":0} ```
Evidence: Live Chrome timer-flag evidence `Live Chrome launched through self-launch/CDP with all three background timer-throttling safeguards present.` ```text [operator] launching browser channel=chrome proxy=direct [operator] egress geo: timezone=America/New_York loc=25.7743,-80.1937 [operator] no DISPLAY — spawned Xvfb at :198 for headed Chrome [operator] self-launch + connectOverCDP (Turnstile-safe launch) binary=/usr/bin/google-chrome {"launch_mode":"xvfb","pid":167086,"required_timer_flags":{"--disable-background-timer-throttling":true,"--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows":true,"--disable-renderer-backgrounding":true},"process_argv":["/opt/google/chrome/chrome --remote-debugging-port=41641 --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --user-data-dir=/tmp/no-mistakes-evidence/01M01B5N83SGFFFF2G70SDHH7M/chrome-profile-transient --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --password-store=basic --window-position=0,0 --window-size=1920,1080 --lang=en-US --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --enable-unsafe-swiftshader --ignore-gpu-blocklist about:blank"]} ```

## Pipeline Updates from [git push no-mistakes](https://github.com/kunchenguid/no-mistakes)
✅ **intent** - passed ✅ No issues found.
🔧 **Rebase** - 2 issues found → auto-fixed ✅ - ⚠️ `apps/mcp/CHANGELOG.md` - merge conflict rebasing onto origin/staging - ⚠️ `apps/mcp/package.json` - merge conflict rebasing onto origin/staging 🔧 Fix applied. ✅ Re-checked - no issues remain.
🔧 **Review** - 3 issues found → auto-fixed (5) ✅ - 🚨 `apps/mcp/src/bot/browser.ts:336` - The intent requires polling the exact live Stripe challenge URL, which includes `stripe_account=acct_...`, but parsing discards that value and the request sends only `Authorization`. Connected-account API requests require the account context via `Stripe-Account`, so this request can return non-OK, be silently treated as undefined, and leave the reported DBS/Shopify failure unchanged. Preserve and validate the account ID and include it in the retrieval request. See [Stripe connected-account authentication](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/authentication). - 🚨 `apps/mcp/src/bot/pay-operator.ts:1299` - The requirement says to make the operator complete OOB 3DS, but only the single-page path passes `challenge_url` and handles `authenticated_pending_order`. The split-checkout confirm path at line 1529 still calls the resolver without the URL and cannot poll/reload; it also lacks mapping for the new result, while its session wrapper does not clear that new terminal status. Route both submit paths through the same challenge-resolution boundary and update confirm lifecycle handling. - ⚠️ `apps/mcp/src/bot/pay-operator.ts:1307` - The new fail-closed status is audited, but the activity consumer classifies only names matching `declin|fail|reject|outcome_unknown` as problematic. `payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order` therefore appears as a normal green “Payment,” contradicting the operator’s warning that order completion is unconfirmed. Give this status an explicit pending/warning presentation. 🔧 Fix: Harden decoupled 3DS completion across payment paths 2 warnings still open: - ⚠️ `apps/mcp/src/bot/browser.ts:10051` - The 30-second confirmation grace period starts before the awaited reload. A slow reload can consume the entire window, causing `authenticated_pending_order` even when the reload lands on a genuine order-completion route because that route is not rechecked before the deadline branch. Start the grace period after reload settles, or recheck the checkout outcome immediately afterward. - ⚠️ `apps/mcp/src/tools/operate-pay.ts:248` - Both new terminal-state branches omit `recordActivePaymentProvenance`, whose existing status guard only covers `payment_submitted` and `payment_3ds_required`. If a manual check later confirms the order and the run is remembered, the recorded recipe can omit the `operate_pay` step and card provenance. Include `payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order` in the provenance condition for both split and single-page flows. 🔧 Fix: Preserve OOB grace timing and payment provenance 1 error still open: - 🚨 `apps/mcp/src/bot/browser.ts:10012` - Stripe polling parameters are parsed only once from the initially detected `challengeUrl`. `detectThreeDsChallenge` can detect a structural child iframe or DBS text in an ancestor frame and return that ancestor’s URL, while the nested `hooks.stripe.com` frame loads later. Parsing then remains undefined forever, so polling never starts and the original OOB timeout remains reachable. Discover the active parseable Stripe challenge URL during the wait until captured, then freeze it to that transaction; cover nested and late-navigating challenge frames. 🔧 Fix: Keep decoupled 3DS challenges active and discoverable 2 issues (1 warning, 1 info) still open: - ⚠️ `AGENTS.md:405` - The new durable guidance says decoupled authentication completes entirely out of band and presents PaymentIntent polling/reload as the fix, but the later live diagnostic established that the Cardinal iframe must remain active to finish its post-approval handshake. Document the three background-throttling flags, `bringToFront()` calls, and the poll's classifier-only role so future maintenance does not preserve the wrong invariant and regress the actual fix. - ℹ️ `AGENTS.md:425` - This adds a second “Maintaining this file” section immediately after the existing one. Merge its useful sentences into the first section to keep the repository contract concise and non-duplicative. 🔧 Fix: Correct 3DS guidance and deduplicate maintenance rules 1 warning still open: - ⚠️ `skills/trusty-squire/SKILL.md:110` - The new public terminal status is missing from the agent-facing payment safety contract. This skill only prohibits blind resubmission for `payment_outcome_unknown`, while README.md:75 and SECURITY.md:165 still imply every unconfirmed 3DS flow returns that older status. After the session ends, a host following these docs may retry `payment_3ds_authenticated_pending_order` without the required manual order check. Document the new status alongside `payment_outcome_unknown`, explicitly forbidding success claims and blind resubmission. 🔧 Fix: Document pending 3DS manual-check safety contract ✅ Re-checked - no issues remain.
